caption: Lewis Wickes Hine, Merilda. Carrying cranberries, Eldridge Bog, near Rochester, Massachusetts (September 1911), photograph for the National Child Labor Committee
alt: A sepia photograph of a small girl in a straw hat, checked dress and long white pinafore, standing in a wide cranberry bog and holding a heavy tin measure of berries in each hand; behind her, women and children kneel picking across the bog, with a barn and a line of pines beyond.
bibliography: Hine, Lewis Wickes. Merilda. Carrying cranberries. Witness, Richard K. Conant. Location: Rochester [vicinity] - Eldridge Bog, Massachusetts. 1911, photographic print, National Child Labor Committee Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, Washington, D.C.
title: Merilda. Carrying cranberries
